Name: Bog's Witchy SVE Buildings
Author: BogWyytch
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FscyBnqN/retro-bookcase-18.png[/img]

Hello! These retextures have been so HIGHLY REQUESTED! I am so happy to have finished them and i hope you enjoy them as much as i am. BEHOLD The Winery, Premium Coop & Premium Barn retextured from Stardew Valley Expanded!

For now this mod does not include the new animals Bear, Camel and Goose. If you would like to see a recolor and retexture like my ghost animals and products for the SVE animals please let me know in the comments section and if you would like them to be with this mod!

I hope you all are having a wonderful July
<3
Bog

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/xTzdGwZy/retro-bookcase-19.png[/img]

I highly recommend utilizing

Gwen's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6086]Medieval SV Expanded[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7332]Way Back Pelican Town[/url] 
DaisyNiko's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolor[/url] 
Aimon's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28948]Witchy Dirt and Grass[/url] 

(This is the combination i am using in screenshots & my own playthrough along with all my mods)

to make the rest of the valley look great with my mods<3 As well as 

Morghoula's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12746]Enchanted Grove Farm Map[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22743]Alchemistry
